versions.changelog:
## Villages Nearby 1.0

First release.

- Villages spawn about 2.4 times as often: one village attempt every 22 chunks instead of every 34 (at least 6 chunks apart instead of 8).
- Plains, desert, savanna, snowy and taiga villages keep their vanilla chances and still only appear in their usual biomes.
- Only land generated after the pack is added gets the extra villages; existing chunks do not change.

## Villages Nearby 1.1

Now also for Minecraft 26.3.

- The same zip works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3, checked against the world generation data of each version and loaded by Minecraft 26.3 itself.
- Villages are as close together as in 1.0, nothing changes on 1.21 and 1.21.1.

## Villages Nearby 1.2

Outposts and temples are closer too.

- Pillager outposts, desert pyramids, jungle temples, swamp huts and igloos spawn about 2.3 times as often: one attempt every 21 chunks instead of every 32 (at least 6 chunks apart instead of 8).
- Villages stay as close together as in 1.1.
- Outposts still keep their distance from villages and stay as rare per attempt as in vanilla; every structure still only appears in its usual biomes.
- Only land generated after the update gets the extra structures; existing chunks do not change.
- Works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3.

## Villages Nearby 1.3

Ocean ruins and shipwrecks are closer too.

- Ocean ruins spawn about 2.4 times as often: one attempt every 13 chunks instead of every 20 (at least 6 chunks apart instead of 8).
- Shipwrecks, sunken and beached, spawn about 2.2 times as often: one attempt every 16 chunks instead of every 24 (at least 3 chunks apart instead of 4).
- Ocean monuments stay as rare as in vanilla: with their gold blocks, sponges and the Mining Fatigue of the elder guardians, more of them would make the oceans both richer and harder to explore than intended.
- Villages, outposts and temples stay as close together as in 1.2; every structure still only appears in its usual biomes.
- Only land generated after the update gets the extra structures; existing chunks do not change.
- Works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3.
